facts.fact: The article states that in most cases sessions time out anywhere between 30 minutes and two hours.
facts.quote: In most cases, sessions time out anywhere between 30 minutes to two hours.

facts.fact: The article states that Google Analytics sessions time out after 30 minutes of inactivity.
facts.quote: Google Analytics’ sessions are timed out after 30 minutes of inactivity.

facts.fact: The article states that two clicks on an ad by the same user within thirty minutes, without closing the browser, are registered by Google Analytics as one session.
facts.quote: If a user clicks on your ad twice within thirty minutes without closing his or her browser, this is registered by Analytics as one session

facts.fact: In the article's example, a user who clicks an ad, goes back, and clicks the ad again is registered by AdWords as two clicks but by Google Analytics as one session.
facts.quote: AdWords registers two clicks while Analytics registers only one session.
